pidfile.description: Path where the daemon writes its process ID (PID) file.

loglevel.description: Minimum log level. Messages at or above this level will be logged.

workers.description: Number of worker threads for concurrent PDU operations. Use 0 to auto-detect based on CPU count.

timeout.description: Default timeout (in seconds) for PDU communication operations.

retries.description: Number of automatic retry attempts after a failed PDU operation.

syslog.description: Whether to send logs to the system logger (syslog).

pdus.description: List of PDU devices to control. Each entry defines one physical or logical PDU.

name.description: Unique identifier for this PDU (used as section name in config).

description.description: Optional human-readable description (e.g., 'Rack A PDU Top').

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PDU management interface.

port.description: TCP port used to connect to the PDU (e.g., 23 for telnet, 80/443 for HTTP(S), 161 for SNMP).

username.description: Username for authentication. If empty, may use default (driver-specific).

password.description: Password for authentication. If empty, may omit or use default (driver-specific).

model.description: Optional PDU model string (e.g., 'AP8959A', 'P3RackPDU'). Used to adjust driver behavior.

snmp_version.description: SNMP version to use (e.g., '1', '2c', '3'). Only applies to SNMP-based drivers.

snmp_community.description: SNMP community string. Only applies to SNMPv1/v2c.

outlet_count.description: Number of controllable outlets on the PDU. If 0, auto-detect (if supported by driver).

timeout.description: Optional per-PDU timeout override (in seconds). If omitted, uses global timeout.

outlet_mapping.description: Optional list of mappings from PDU.outlet → user-friendly label (e.g., for UI or reporting).

pdu_name.description: Name of the PDU (must match a section in [pdu:*]).

label.description: Human-readable label for the outlet (e.g., 'Server Rack A-01', 'Network Switch 1').
